LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_SettingsTip: Choose the pawn to configure and both test participants inside the window. Selecting a pawn beforehand is optional.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_SettingsUnavailable: Load a save and open a map with a configurable pawn to use this interface.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_TestNotice: Ordinary RJW pair, solo, personality-excretion, daily training and ritual jobs now use these rules. Event prechecks and dedicated compatibility paths await later integration.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_OwnerNotice: The actual owner initiating any interaction with their own bound pawn is immediately allowed. Equipment and individual restrictions cannot veto this.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_SystemSwitchTip: Enables or disables interaction restrictions globally. Jobs awaiting integration still share the legacy master switch. Disabling does not erase saved pawn choices.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_ProfileSwitchTip: Global setting. Only controls specialization overrides in the new system; equipment overrides and saved values are unaffected.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_NotApplicable: This pawn is not managed by the new system: SSC slave identity or an existing owner bond is required. Any existing configuration is read-only.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Uninitialized: No configuration yet: automatic initialization may have failed or migration may be pending. Retry after fixing defaults. Pending legacy data will not be replaced by manual defaults.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_InvalidConfig: Unsupported or invalid configuration (version {0}). Editing is disabled; original data has been preserved.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_SaveNotice: Edits are applied immediately and saved with the game. Saved values remain editable while overridden and are used again when the override ends.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_EditFailed: Cannot edit: the pawn's applicability or configuration changed. Please check it again.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_InitializeFailed: Cannot create configuration: the default for rule "{0}" is invalid. Source: {1}. No configuration was written to the pawn.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Rule_ReceiveConsensual: Passive · Receive consensual interaction from non-owners
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Rule_ReceiveForced: Passive · Receive forced interaction from non-owners
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_TestAsReceiver: Test with this pawn as receiver
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_SoloTip: Results use saved configurations live; no jobs are started. Solo interactions only check the initiator and ignore the receiver selection.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Reason_NotApplicable: Relevant pawns are not managed by this system
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Reason_ConfigurationMis: Relevant pawn has no new configuration; initialize it on the individual rules page
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Reason_ConfigurationInv: Invalid configuration version, rule or file override
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Reason_OwnerOnly: Initiation is limited to this pawn's actual owner
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_Reason_InvalidBindingPr: Identity or assignment does not qualify for first binding preparation
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_DefaultsTip: Defaults apply when a pawn first becomes eligible. Existing choices are retained; first acquiring the Bus specialization applies its two reception defaults.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_InvalidDefaults: The default template is invalid. Check the configuration file; existing pawn settings are preserved.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_ApplyAll: Apply defaults to all eligible pawns in this save…
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_ApplyConfirm: This overwrites individual choices for all eligible pawns in the current save, including other maps, caravans, transport and world pawns. The current template and each pawn’s specialization defaults will be applied; equipment overrides will not be saved. Continue?
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_TrainerLocked: Non-owner training is denied. The assigned trainer is locked to the bound owner: {0}.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_CommandRejected: Current interaction restrictions deny this command. Check the pawn restriction panel for initiation, reception and forced rule sources.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_TrainingTargetInvalid: The target has no valid training data or cannot receive training with the current identity.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_BindingMasterRequired: Preparing a first bond requires the assigned candidate to have Master identity.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_TrainingAssignmentRequi: Training requires the active assigned trainer. Other pawns do not automatically take over.
LanguageData.SSC_Restrictions_RitualCancelled: The next ritual phase cannot start. The ritual has been cancelled: {0}
